name: Acharya Prashant Pandey
bio: Acharya Prashant Pandey is a highly experienced and respected Vedic astrologer (Jyotishacharya) with over 20 years of expertise in astrology, Vedic rituals, and Vastu Shastra. He has guided 1500+ individuals and families in making life decisions related to career, marriage, finance, health, and spiritual growth.
education: Jyotishacharya (Phalit Jyotish) from Banaras Hindu University (BHU)

name: Pt. Ramesh Kumar Sharma
bio: Pandit Ramesh Kumar Sharma is a 3rd-generation Vedic priest from Kashi tradition, trained in Maharashtra and Varanasi. With over 22 years of experience, he specializes in elaborate household ceremonies and Vedic yagnas.
education: Shastri from Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, Varanasi

name: Pt. Venkatesh Raghavan
bio: A revered South Indian Shrivaishnava brahmin priest from the Tanjore tradition, Pandit Venkatesh brings the rich Agamic tradition of Tamil Brahmin worship to households across Tamil Nadu and Karnataka.

name: Pt. Suresh Bhat Kulkarni
bio: Pandit Suresh Bhat is a Kokanastha Brahmin priest deeply versed in both Rigvedic and Yajurvedic rituals. He performs all Maharashtra traditions including Satyanarayan, 16 Samskaras, and Ganapati festivals.
education: Vedic Studies from Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth

name: Pt. Narasimha Murthy
bio: Pandit Narasimha Murthy comes from the Smarta Brahmin tradition of Karnataka, trained at the renowned Sringeri Mutt. He is an expert in both North and South Indian wedding ceremonies.

name: Pt. Krishnagopal Bhattacharya
bio: Pandit Krishnagopal is a traditional Bengali tantric priest and Durga Puja specialist, trained at Dakshineswar. He performs all major Bengali pujas including elaborate Durga Puja with traditional Navapatra rituals.

name: Pt. Mukesh Pandya
bio: Pandit Mukesh Pandya is a Nagar Brahmin from Ahmedabad, deeply versed in Gujarati Vaishnava traditions. He specializes in business-related pujas including office openings, Diwali Lakshmi puja, and factory inaugurations.
education: Vedic Studies from Harikrishna Shastri Gurukul

name: Pt. Narayana Iyer
bio: Pandit Narayana Iyer is a Smarta Brahmin priest from the Andhra-Telugu tradition, trained at the Tirupati Devasthanams. He specializes in planetary remedies, dosha nivarana, and elaborate yagnas.

name: Pt. Dhirendra Prasad
bio: Pandit Dhirendra Prasad is a Maithil Brahmin priest specializing in all 16 Vedic samskaras and Bihar-specific traditions. He serves families across Bihar, Jharkhand, and eastern UP.

name: Pt. Ravi Shankar Joshi
bio: Pandit Ravi Shankar Joshi is a young, highly educated Deshastha Brahmin priest trained in both traditional and modern approaches. He is fluent in explaining rituals clearly to younger families.

name: Pt. Srinivasa Rao
bio: Pandit Srinivasa Rao is an Iyer Brahmin priest from the Shaiva tradition, trained at the Rameshwaram temple. He is highly sought after for his melodious chanting and deep knowledge of Shaiva Agamas.
